messages.content: tumi ki mone koro love at first sight real jinis?
Attraction at first sight real, kintu love ta mone hoy beshi deep kichu, time lage. Tumi ki eta experience korecho kokhono?
hae mone hoy, but ekhon confuse j oita love chilo naki just attraction
Eta khub common confusion actually. Sei somoy er por relationship ta ki hoyechilo, naki oi ekta muhurte e limited?
kichu din kotha hoyechilo tarpor slowly fade hoye geche
Tahole seta attraction chilo beshi mone hoy, ja proper connection e convert hoyni. Love shadharonoto ekta muhurte theme na, eta build hoy time ar shared experience diye.
